entry.title: Introducing Claude for Nonprofits
entry.summary:
Anthropic has launched Claude for Nonprofits, offering eligible organizations up to 75% off Team and Enterprise plans, new open-source software connectors, and a free AI training course.

Why it matters: This initiative significantly lowers the financial and technical barriers for non-profit organizations to integrate advanced AI models and specialized data connectors into their operational workflows.

entry.title: Apple is getting this wrong
entry.summary:
OpenAI responded to a lawsuit from Apple by denying its claims, clarifying information regarding its employees, and releasing documenting messages.

Why it matters: The response publicly challenges Apple's legal claims and provides documentation to refute allegations concerning OpenAI's personnel.

entry.title: How we built a realtime system for responsive voice AI in six months
entry.summary:

Why it matters: The system enables faster, more natural human-AI voice conversations by eliminating traditional turn-based constraints.

entry.title: Quoting Steve Yegge
entry.summary:
